verdict.rationale: Passkey storage and sync is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents syncing TOTP/HOTP verification codes through a Google Account and QR-code transfer between devices. Nothing shows the product storing or syncing passkeys, or running on Windows, Linux or in browsers, and code sync is an adjacent feature that does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor
